scope: Fixed exploratory cohort, not population success estimation. Geometry failures remain in all 24 planned denominators. No candidate replacement or evaluator-based selection.
protocol: GPU4PySCF PBE0/def2-TZVP/DF single points; PBE-D3BJ/def2-TZVP/DF geometry optimization. Approximate OE62 comparison, not identical Tier2/PBE-TS protocol.

selection.selection_rule: Choose completed GRPO stage with lowest macro A-only raw MAE on 18 matched development cells. Freeze A-top1 and a fixed hash-uniform draw from remaining unique eligible graphs per task/target/method before model B or quantum evaluation.
selection.eligibility: Original chemical validity + original AD + common vocabulary + <=80 all-source atoms; no target-hit or low-force filter.
